summary: Create automated on-call retrospective Slack channel + Confluence sync with Jira action-item creation
description:
Issue summary: Request provisioning of an automated retrospective workflow that ties a short-lived Slack channel to a Confluence retrospective page and auto-creates Jira action items for follow-ups.

Impact: Reduces manual post-incident overhead for on-call teams and ensures action items are captured and tracked consistently across SRE and product pods. Target audience: on-call SREs and incident responders across infra/product pods.

Requested change: 1) Provision a templated ephemeral Slack channel namespace (pattern: retros-<team>-YYYYMMDD or retros-<service>-oncall) that is created via slash command or a single-click Console action. 2) When a channel is archived (or after 48 hours of inactivity), a bot should compile pinned messages, thread highlights, and a short autogenerated summary into a Confluence page under the Retrospectives space using the standard incident-retro template. 3) Extract items prefixed with ACTION: or TODO: and create linked Jira tasks in the team's Jira project, assigning to the person mentioned or to the on-call owner if none specified. 4) Channel lifecycle: auto-archive after 7 days of inactivity, retain messages for 90 days in Slack before deletion, but keep the Confluence retrospective indefinitely. 5) Owner rotation: weekly rotate the channel steward role to the next on-call primary (integration with oncall roster). 6) Optional toggle to enable an AI-assistant draft that proposes a 3-5 bullet action summary for the Confluence page (opt-in per team).

Environment: prod slack org, Redwood Confluence (Retrospectives space), Jira (team projects).

Permissions/requirements: The automation needs a bot with scopes: channels:manage, channels:history, chat:write, files:write, confluence.create, confluence.read, jira:issue:create, users:read. Okta service account with least privilege to run the flow. Audit logging must be enabled for channel creation/archival actions.

Acceptance criteria: see acceptance_criteria field for discrete checks and verification steps.
steps_to_reproduce: N/A - provisioning request rather than bug. Example flow for acceptance testing: 1) Run /create-retro retros-myservice in #tools-sandbox. 2) Post 3 pinned messages and 2 threads, mark one message with ACTION: assign to @alice. 3) Wait 1 minute, trigger manual 'compile' (or wait for inactivity window). 4) Verify Confluence page created with template populated, pinned items included, AI draft present if enabled. 5) Verify Jira task created for ACTION item and linked back to Confluence page. 6) Verify archival and owner rotation happened per schedule.
acceptance_criteria: Slash command or Console button successfully creates a channel with name pattern retros-<team>-<date>
Automation bot compiles pinned messages and thread summaries into a Confluence page using incident-retro template
Items prefixed with ACTION: or TODO: result in Jira tasks created in the correct Jira project and assigned appropriately
Confluence page includes a link back to the Slack channel and to created Jira tasks
Channel auto-archives after 7 days of inactivity and retention/deletion behavior matches policy (90-day Slack retention, Confluence retained indefinitely)
Owner/steward rotates weekly based on oncall roster integration
Permissions are limited to required scopes and audit log entries are generated for channel create/archive and Confluence page creation
Opt-in AI draft present when enabled and flagged in the page metadata; team can disable AI drafting
